Paper design · Project reports

Local-model generation and verification pilot

15 October 2026 · Development experiment under ADR-023.

Start with five selected generated examples and their evidence.

Implementation: automatic claim compilation, frozen observations, DeepProbLog inference, and sample training (22 October 2026).

This report covers the five inspected L40S pilot configurations. Later A100 outputs require a separate sample-quality review and are not included in these counts.

Evidence and label limits. The assistant inspected eight sampled frames per clip. The generation model received descriptions; visual reviews and baselines received the saved frames. No audio was supplied. Proposed labels and model reviews are automatic. Assistant checks are development annotations, not independent human gold. These results do not establish paper accuracy or a benefit from probabilistic inference. Whole-claim scores are uncalibrated probabilities normalized over A/B/C output tokens.

The source-video IDs are outside the 102 videos in existing phase-3 gold packages. This checks those packages only, not all possible duplicates. The report shows all schema-valid candidates, including poor edits and disagreements. The text-only control receives an explicit statement that no media is available; it checks abstention rather than measuring a trained linguistic shortcut detector.

What the pilot established

Three free-form prompt versions produced 11, 10, and 29 candidate variants on the same ten inputs. Assistant inspection found 0, 0, and 1 clean binding negatives respectively. A separate test with two explicit, checked attribute-swap plans produced two faithful negatives and one usable positive paraphrase; an exact duplicate was dropped.

The failures include incorrect edit labels, refusal to create intentionally false assignments, extra attribute changes, still-true edits under another alignment, an incorrect initial chair-location description, and an uncertain clothing category. Original input records and the later corrections are preserved separately. The eight remaining eligible seeds feed the queued larger-model trial.

The whole-claim model lowers support from 0.99980 to 0.000021 for the clothing swap, and from approximately 1.00000 to 0.000010 for the aircraft/bus color swap. It predicts unknown for both negatives rather than refuted. Matched component questions cannot separate the pairs. Complete-relation conjunction does not establish a gain over whole-claim verification. This is a pipeline diagnostic on two development pairs, not a held-out method result.

Recommendation: check a small set of facts against media, make specified edits in code, and use the LLM to write the target facts. Audit its output. Compare direct verification and calibration before training the small relation classifier. Automatic decomposition remains a material source of error; the checked-form comparison is explicitly a diagnostic.

Five L40S jobs completed: 19 minutes 52 seconds of allocated GPU time (about 0.33 GPU-hours), including initialization. There were 702 new model requests; 15 identical observations were reused for the checked-form comparison. A100 jobs 1028682 and 1028694 have saved automatic outputs for 32 further claims. Their quality review is pending; these outputs are outside this initial five-run report. Audio, classifier training, and probabilistic inference were not run.
